claims.claim: Versioned FAILURE projections preserve bound identities and integer or null native exits without rewriting original private records.
Readers retain historical formats, represent missing observation detail explicitly, and reject malformed bindings without manufacturing fingerprints or PASS evidence.
Public diagnostics expose allowlisted causes and capture statuses, preserve admissible quoted pytest commands, and reject malicious quoting and credential arguments.
Dirty-candidate handling supports artifact-only FAILURE transport and bound attention, with typed transport blockers readable by Unified State.
BP-2 attention context retains allowlisted operational causes with run_created=false and creates no terminal or correction identity.
Attention, Unified State, Brain Sync and provider contexts expose bounded failure facts with candidate, source and evidence identities.
Local private-read APIs check persisted admission, workspace, RUN, subject, exact locator and byte digest, restricting raw verification access to same-RUN candidate captures.
Synthetic regression fixtures cover normal and hostile projections, null exits, dirty candidates, BP-2, attention, Brain/provider context, private access and command safety.
